data.case_title: Fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) from Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven – Bußgeldstelle (Az. 32.12-26/61107)
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) from the city's fine office (Bußgeldstelle) because the vehicle's roadworthiness inspection (Hauptuntersuchung/TÜV) was more than four months overdue when it was driven. It also adds 1 point to the driver register (Fahreignungsregister). You may decide whether to accept the fine or file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or in person at the Bußgeldstelle; the app shows until when you can still do so. If you do not object in time, the notice becomes final (rechtskräftig) and the total of €92.00 becomes due two weeks after that; unpaid fines can be enforced. If anything about the alleged offence seems wrong, consider getting advice before the deadline shown.

items.title: Decide on filing an objection (Einspruch)
items.action: Decide whether to accept the fine or file an objection (Einspruch) against it, in writing or by declaration to the record (zur Niederschrift) at the Bußgeldstelle.
items.consequence: If you do not object within the period, the notice becomes final and enforceable.
items.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung bei der Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Gesamtbetrag)
items.action: Pay the total amount of €92.00 once the notice becomes legally final, i.e. if you do not file an objection in time (or after an objection is resolved against you).
items.consequence: Unpaid fines after the due date can lead to enforcement measures (Vollstreckung).
items.quote: Fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist.

key_facts.label: Points in driver register (Fahreignungsregister)
key_facts.quote: Im Fahreignungsregister wird der Verstoß mit 1 Punkt vermerkt.

remedy.quote: Einspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist zulässig. Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung bei der Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.

data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle (fine office) of Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) against Fenja Musterwolde for driving a vehicle on 1 October 2026 whose roadworthiness inspection (Hauptuntersuchung) was more than four months overdue. The total amount due is €92.00 (€60.00 fine, €28.50 fee, €3.50 delivery costs) plus 1 point in the driver register, and an objection (Einspruch) can be filed within two weeks of delivery.
data.title: Bußgeldbescheid – fine for overdue vehicle inspection (TÜV)
